::: {.callout-note .se-question appearance="simple"}
## The question

[Is it possible to change the size of an arrowhead in TikZ/PGF?](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/5461/is-it-possible-to-change-the-size-of-an-arrowhead-in-tikz-pgf), asked by [yegor256](https://tex.stackexchange.com/users/1449/yegor256) on TeX Stack Exchange (2010-11-16; [CC BY-SA 2.5](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/)):

> I'm trying to draw an arrow with a bigger head than normal. Is it possible without changing the style of the line itself?
:::

Here is a sample of the outward-pointing triangular tips in PGF/TikZ 2.10 (see Section 24 "Arrow Tip Library" of [the 2.10 manual][2]):

```latex
\documentclass{minimal}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows}
\begin{document}
\newcounter{tmp}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\foreach \s in {latex,latex',stealth,triangle 90,triangle 45,angle 90, angle 60} {
    \stepcounter{tmp}
	\begin{scope}[yshift=-\thetmp cm]
	    \node[anchor=west] (0,0) {\texttt{\s}};	    
	    \draw[arrows={\s-\s}] (3,0) --++ (1,0);
	\end{scope}
}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
```

![arrows][1]

If you want something more customized or more specific, read Section 82 "Arrow Tips" of  [the 2.10 manual of pgf][2].  How much bigger and in what direction are you looking for?


  [1]: 6all8.png
  [2]: http://www.texample.net/media/pgf/builds/pgfmanualCVS2012-11-04.pdf
